indeterminate.finding: In `make hooks`, `pre-commit install` runs BEFORE `sh scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh`. On a genuinely fresh worktree (the exact scenario the docs target), pre-commit has no pre-existing commit-msg hook to migrate, so it writes a wrapper that does NOT chain to `commit-msg.legacy`. The installer then sees the pre-commit wrapper and installs the Gerrit stamper into `commit-msg.legacy` — where the non-migration wrapper never invokes it. Change-Id stamping is silently absent, reintroducing bug 84aa's failure mode by a different route. Installing the Gerrit hook FIRST (into the empty `commit-msg` slot) so that `pre-commit install` migrates it to `.legacy` and chains to it would be correct.
indeterminate.suggested_fix: Reorder the two lines in `make hooks`: run `sh scripts/install-gerrit-hook.sh || true` before `pre-commit install`, so on a fresh checkout the stamper occupies `commit-msg` first and pre-commit's migration mode moves it to `commit-msg.legacy` and chains to it.
